mentions.name: Whilemusic (whilemusic.net)
mentions.description: A web app that generates synthesizer music in real time. It wraps a genetic MIDI generation engine originally built as a CLI tool to drive hardware synthesizers, now presented as a web version with a built-in Csound software synthesizer and example patches.
mentions.audience: There was no larger goal besides having fun; example Csound patches are used as the author's own background music.
mentions.source_excerpt:
https://whilemusic.net/ - Generative hard- or software- synthesizer music.

The core engine (genetic MIDI generation) started 3 years ago to drive hardware synthesizers. That was good old handcrafted code, just a CLI tool.

At some point I thought I was done with it, but AI coding tools let me build a nicer GUI around it and make it more accessible. Eventually a web version with built in Csound soft synth resulted which is where it's at now.
mentions.author: mco
